quiz.title: histoire/géographie : événements historiques, lieux, repères temporels
quiz.subject: Anglais

answers.correction: George Washington was the first President of the United States.
The Great Wall of China was indeed built as a defense against invasions from nomadic tribes.
Asia, Europe, and Africa are all continents.
The Renaissance was indeed a significant period of cultural and artistic development in Europe.
The Colosseum, The Pyramids of Giza, and The Taj Mahal are all famous historical landmarks.
World War II ended in 1945 with the surrender of Germany and Japan.
The Nile, Amazon, and Mississippi are all major rivers in the world.
The Industrial Revolution was indeed a period of significant technological and economic change that began in the late 18th century.
